ClientResponses.Response: Hello! We are sorry to hear about your disappointment with the design of your grill. What you notice is normal on a new grill. The grease leaking is caused by vapors produced while cooking food that collects on the interior surfaces of the lid. The interior surfaces on a new grill are so smooth that the vapors collect and run down the surfaces. As the grill is used more, the grease will subside as the lid will no longer be as smooth. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I was very impressed with the build quality and performance of this grill, my first Weber by the way. It seems to cook evenly and it heats up very quickly. It took awhile to learn to adjust cooking temps but I think I've got that handled. I absolutely love the ability to remove and clean the bottom tray. Scraping it out was a breeze and the porcelain finish helped a great deal. The removable drip pan was certainly more accessible than on my previous grills. My only disappointment is with hooking up the propane tank. The regulator hose assembly leaves very little wiggle room and doesn't allow for attaching other tank accessories. I have a leak tester assembly I've used for years but can't use now because the regulator hose isn't long enough. It's barely look enough to attach to the tank. My tank fits best on the scale when facing away from the door opening, i.e with the tank valve facing the drip pan shelf. I think Weber could supply a little longer hose assembly. I deducted one star because of this.

Results.ReviewText: This Weber is more cheaply made than its predecessor. Still, it is a good grill. Not easy to move around as the wheels are much too small.
Results.Title: Liking our Weber.

Results.ReviewText: Have the 310. Used a few times. Very impressed with the overall performance. Heats up real quickly and cooks evenly and fast. I’m enjoying this bbq. Can’t wait to expand on my menus
Results.Title: Grilling done right

Results.ReviewText: Very nice grill. Hadn't used it much but it cooks great. Heats up quickly and evenly so far. I cooked chicken,  burgers, tibs,  & hot dogs.  Also used a pellet tube which set it off nicely. Sharp looking grill, sturdy with decent storage. What more can I say it's a Weber. Would rate higher but don't have enough use on it.
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: We had a very old grill and weren't sure whether a Weber would be worth it.  IT WAS!  We love our weber.  I cook out now about 3-4 times a week.  Can't wait to retire and be able to do this daily.
Results.Title: Food almost cooks itself

Results.ReviewText: We are very pleased with our new Spirit E-310. We had our old Spirit about 20 years and found the new one to be even quicker and have cooked some different items on this new grill and found it to be very improved. Thank you

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
